title: Two Wheeler Ramp
description: High Quality Two Wheeler Ramp suitable for all kind of two wheeler with foot operated hydraulic piston.
subtitle: Two Wheeler Ramp
fullDescription: We manufacture High Quality Two Wheeler Ramp suitable for all kind of two wheeler. Features textured sheet metal used in lift table for extra grip and strength, zero oil spillage design for foot operated hydraulic piston, front tyre holding vice for extra safety while lifting, and foot operated hydraulic system for easy lifting.
features: Textured Sheet Metal Used in Lift Table for Extra Grip and Strength
Zero Oil Spillage Design for Foot operated Hydraulic piston
Front Tyre Holding Vice for Extra Safety while lifting
Extra Textured Sheet for centre stand support
Backside Sliding Sheet for easy rolling of two wheeler into the Lift Table
Frontside Sliding Sheet to prevent two wheeler to roll out of the Lift Table
Foot Operated Hydraulic System for easy lifting
